raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Starting with delivery batch 14 (ingested 2026-01-19), raw_transactions.merchant_id arrives as 'M-0NNN' (for example 'M-0131') instead of the plain integer 'NNN', so the INTEGER cast in silver_transactions fails. Mapping the new format back to the integer is supported by the profile: 80 distinct values is the same 40 merchants in two formats, and the prefixed range M-0100..M-0139 matches raw_merchants 100..139 exactly.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CASE WHEN merchant_id LIKE 'M-%' THEN CAST(substr(merchant_id, 3) AS INTEGER) ELSE CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) END AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
